source.title: OpenAI fires three safety researchers for "mishandling research information"
source.author: trakkstar

title.zh: OpenAI安全研究员被解雇争议
title.en: OpenAI Safety Researchers Face Firing Dispute

excerpt.zh: OpenAI安全研究员被解雇后否认不当处理研究信息，称模糊规则可能压制安全讨论；公司则称调查发现了更广泛的违规模式，事件凸显外部评估与内部保密之间的治理张力。
excerpt.en: OpenAI safety researchers dispute their dismissal, while the company cites broader misconduct and the case raises questions about transparency.

text.zh: OpenAI安全研究员为何被解雇
text.en: Why OpenAI Safety Researchers Were Fired

text.zh: OpenAI安全研究员Jasmine Wang、Tomek Korbak和Mikita Balesni公开否认公司关于其不当处理研究信息的指控。三人称，他们与外部安全组织沟通，是为了推进评估、监测和风险研究，并认为相关行为符合当时的工作规范。
text.en: OpenAI safety researchers Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak, and Mikita Balesni publicly denied the company’s claim that they mishandled research information. They said their contacts with outside safety groups were intended to support evaluation, monitoring, and risk research, and that they believed the work followed the norms in place at the time.

text.zh: OpenAI则表示，解雇源于调查发现的“违规模式”，范围不止于向外部人工智能评估组织分享信息。公司一份内部备忘录称，决定并非针对提出安全问题或公开表达异议，但公司没有公开说明具体违反了哪些政策，也未详细解释解雇过程。
text.en: OpenAI said an investigation found a broader “pattern of misconduct,” extending beyond the sharing of information with an external AI evaluation group. An internal memo said the dismissals were not retaliation for raising safety concerns or speaking openly. However, the company has not publicly identified the specific policies involved or detailed how the terminations were handled.

text.zh: 争议指向人工智能安全治理
text.en: The Dispute Exposes AI Safety Governance Tensions

text.zh: 研究人员警告，突然解雇和不清晰的规则可能让员工不敢报告风险，也会削弱第三方监督。他们还否认参与向媒体泄露有关模型可监测性的材料，并称自己在处理一次异常代理事件及相关研究时，曾与内部管理层和外部评估者保持沟通。
text.en: The researchers warned that abrupt dismissals and unclear rules could discourage employees from reporting risks and weaken third-party oversight. They also denied involvement in a media leak about model monitorability, and said that while handling an unusual agent incident and related research, they communicated with internal leaders and external evaluators.

text.zh: 这起事件的核心并不只是一次人事争议，而是前沿人工智能实验室如何平衡信息保密、外部审查和安全研究协作。若研究人员需要先判断哪些沟通可能触发纪律处分，安全工作本身可能受到影响；但在敏感信息管理上，清晰且可执行的边界同样不可缺少。
text.en: The dispute is therefore about more than an employment decision. It highlights how frontier AI labs must balance confidentiality with outside scrutiny and safety collaboration. Researchers who must guess which discussions could trigger discipline may become less willing to investigate risks, while clear and enforceable controls for sensitive information remain necessary.

text.zh: 目前双方说法仍未完全对齐。OpenAI尚未公开具体政策依据、调查证据或员工提出安全问题时的保护机制；研究人员则呼吁公司兑现引入第三方安全审计、维护前沿模型可监测性并保持开放对话的承诺。后续透明度将决定这场争议是个案，还是更广泛治理变化的信号。
text.en: The two accounts are still unresolved. OpenAI has not published the specific policy basis, investigative evidence, or protections available to employees who raise safety concerns. The researchers have urged the company to support third-party safety audits, preserve frontier-model monitorability, and maintain open dialogue. Further transparency will show whether this was an isolated dispute or evidence of a broader governance shift.
